audience.otherprops: executive leadership,plant management,safety and compliance officers,operations teams,maintenance personnel

othermeta.content: Environment Health and Safety Principles
othermeta.name: title

othermeta.content: Defines organisational EHS principles to establish leadership accountability and a zero incident culture in glass manufacturing.
othermeta.name: shortdesc

othermeta.content: float line furnace;lehr oven;conveyor systems;material handling equipment;process chemicals;workforce
othermeta.name: entities

othermeta.content: domain:ehs;usecase:policy-and-principles;industry:glass manufacturing heavy machinery and industrial equipment

othermeta.content: establish organisational safety principles and leadership responsibilities
othermeta.name: usecase

ol.li: EHS is everyone’s responsibility as an employee of Space: EHS will be led from the top down and owned at every level throughout the organization on the basis of MUTUAL TRUST and appreciation.
EHS will always look for resolution instead of blame in the incident/injury resolution process.

EHS pledges to be Simple, Practical, Effective, and Swift in response to customer needs in the incident/injury resolution process.
Definition of customers:
Employees
Visitors
Contractors
Stakeholders within and outside of the Space family
Definition of focus: mitigation and/or elimination of risk to
People
Strategy
Execution
